D5/S3/Quantum/ShorContinuedFractions.sho.name: QuantumShorContinuedFractions.shor_coprime_candidate
D5/S3/Quantum/ShorContinuedFractions.sho.signature: theorem shor_coprime_candidate (c : Parameters) (n : ℕ) (hsize : c.modulus ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ n) (s : Fin c.period) (y : Fin (2 ^ n)) (hnear : Nearest (2 ^ n) (s.val / (c.period : ℝ)) y) (hcop : Nat.Coprime s.val c.period) : c.period ∈ (candidates y.val (2 ^ n) c.modulus).map Rat.den

D5/S3/Quantum/ShorContinuedFractions.sho.name: QuantumShorContinuedFractions.shor_nearest_candidate
D5/S3/Quantum/ShorContinuedFractions.sho.signature: theorem shor_nearest_candidate (c : Parameters) (n : ℕ) (hsize : c.modulus ^ 2 ≤ 2 ^ n) (s : Fin c.period) (y : Fin (2 ^ n)) (hnear : Nearest (2 ^ n) (s.val / (c.period : ℝ)) y) : reduced s.val c.period ∈ candidates y.val (2 ^ n) c.modulus ∧ (reduced s.val c.period).den ∣ c.period
